import os, pickle
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

seed = 42
num = pd.read_csv(artifact_path('numeric_features.csv'))
features = list(num.columns)
X = num.values.astype(float)
scaler = StandardScaler().fit(X)
Xs = scaler.transform(X)

ks = list(range(2, 9))
models = {}
inertias = []
for k in ks:
    km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=seed, n_init=10)
    km.fit(Xs)
    models[k] = km
    inertias.append(float(km.inertia_))
inertias = np.array(inertias)

# elbow selection: max distance below normalized endpoint chord
dist = 1 - (np.array(ks) - 2) / 6 - (inertias - inertias[-1]) / (inertias[0] - inertias[-1])
best_idx = int(np.argmax(dist))
best_k = ks[best_idx]

labels = models[best_k].labels_
clusters = pd.DataFrame({'ID': num.index + 1, 'cluster': labels})
